name: Storzen Product Compare for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen Product Compare for WooCommerce lets your customers compare products side by side on a dedicated compare page — helping them make faster, more confident purchase decisions.
📖 Full Documentation

Features

  • ✅ Dedicated Compare Page (auto-created on activation)
  • ✅ Add to Compare button on shop loop & single product page
  • ✅ Compare up to 5 products simultaneously
  • ✅ Compare fields: Image, Title, Price, Rating, SKU, Availability, Description, Add to Cart
  • ✅ Elementor widget for the compare table
  • ✅ AJAX add/remove — no page reloads
  • ✅ Toast notifications with View Comparison link
  • ✅ Remove individual products from comparison
  • ✅ Clear All button
  • ✅ Responsive table layout
  • ✅ WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • ✅ WooCommerce Blocks compatible (Products block, All Products block)
  • ✅ WooCommerce 7.0+ compatible
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/storzen-product-compare-for-woocommerce or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. A “Compare Products” page will be created automatically.
  4. Go to Compare Products menu in WordPress admin to configure settings.
  5. The “Compare” button will appear automatically on your shop and product pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work without Elementor?

Yes. The Compare button and Compare Page work without Elementor. The Elementor widget is an optional enhancement for placing the compare table inside any Elementor layout.

Where is the Compare page?

It is created automatically on activation with the shortcode [storprco_compare_table]. You can also assign any existing page in the Compare Products settings.

How many products can be compared?

Up to 5 products can be compared at once (configurable in settings).

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. Storzen Product Compare for WooCommerce uses WooCommerce-standard hooks and outputs clean HTML that inherits your theme styles.
